tasks.subject: Rebuild dist/ from source and verify artifact contents
tasks.description: Run `nub run build` to regenerate dist/. Verify the fresh artifact: dist/openapi.js uses Web Crypto (no node:crypto import), arktypeValidator throws APIError on ArkErrors, no createRoute anywhere, dist/api.d.ts declares debug option on createApi, dist/index.d.ts exposes AuthScheme/ArkType/RouteConfig.

tasks.subject: Add artifact freshness gate (prepublish + CI)
tasks.description: Commit dist/ (remove from .gitignore) so a reference artifact exists. Add check:dist script = `nub run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist/`, wire into prepublishOnly, and add a CI step in .github/workflows/publish.yml before npm publish. Prove the gate fails on stale dist and passes on fresh dist.

tasks.subject: Full verification: typecheck, check:all, spec snapshot
tasks.description: Run `nub run typecheck` + `nub run check:all` green. Spec snapshot (examples/blog/spec.snapshot.json) must be unchanged. Also run npm pack --dry-run to confirm what ships. Commit work to master per implement skill.
